verses.text: Now as to the times and the epochs, brethren, you have no need of anything to be written to you.
verses.textZh: 弟兄們，論到時候、日期，不用寫信給你們；

verses.text: For you yourselves know full well that the day of the Lord will come just like a thief in the night.
verses.textZh: 因為你們自己明明曉得，主的日子來到，好像夜間的賊一樣。

verses.text: While they are saying, 'Peace and safety!' then destruction will come upon them suddenly like labor pains upon a woman with child, and they will not escape.
verses.textZh: 人正說平安穩妥的時候，災禍忽然臨到他們，如同產難臨到懷胎的婦人一樣。他們絕不能逃脫。

verses.text: But you, brethren, are not in darkness, that the day would overtake you like a thief;
verses.textZh: 弟兄們，你們卻不在黑暗裡，叫那日子臨到你們像賊一樣。

verses.text: for you are all sons of light and sons of day. We are not of night nor of darkness;
verses.textZh: 你們都是光明之子，都是白晝之子。我們不是屬黑夜的，也不是屬幽暗的。

verses.text: so then let us not sleep as others do, but let us be alert and sober.
verses.textZh: 所以我們不要睡覺像別人一樣，總要儆醒謹守。

verses.text: For those who sleep do their sleeping at night, and those who get drunk get drunk at night.
verses.textZh: 因為睡了的人是在夜間睡，醉了的人是在夜間醉。

verses.text: But since we are of [the] day, let us be sober, having put on the breastplate of faith and love, and as a helmet, the hope of salvation.
verses.textZh: 但我們既然屬乎白晝，就應當謹守，把信和愛當作護心鏡遮胸，把得救的盼望當作頭盔戴上。

verses.text: For God has not destined us for wrath, but for obtaining salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textZh: 因為神不是預定我們受刑，乃是預定我們藉著我們主耶穌基督得救。

verses.text: who died for us, so that whether we are awake or asleep, we will live together with Him.
verses.textZh: 他替我們死，叫我們無論醒著、睡著，都與他同活。

verses.text: Therefore encourage one another and build up one another, just as you also are doing.
verses.textZh: 所以，你們該彼此勸慰，互相建立，正如你們素常所行的。

verses.text: But we request of you, brethren, that you appreciate those who diligently labor among you, and have charge over you in the Lord and give you instruction,
verses.textZh: 弟兄們，我們勸你們敬重那在你們中間勞苦的人，就是在主裡面治理你們、勸戒你們的。

verses.text: and that you esteem them very highly in love because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
verses.textZh: 又因他們所做的工，用愛心格外尊重他們。你們也要彼此和睦。

verses.text: We urge you, brethren, admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, be patient with everyone.
verses.textZh: 我們又勸弟兄們，要警戒不守規矩的人，勉勵灰心的人，扶助軟弱的人，也要向眾人忍耐。

verses.text: See that no one repays another with evil for evil, but always seek after that which is good for one another and for all people.
verses.textZh: 你們要謹慎，無論是誰都不可以惡報惡；或是彼此相待，或是待眾人，常要追求良善。

verses.text: Rejoice always;
verses.textZh: 要常常喜樂，

verses.text: pray without ceasing;
verses.textZh: 不住的禱告，

verses.text: in everything give thanks; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.
verses.textZh: 凡事謝恩；因為這是神在基督耶穌裡向你們所定的旨意。

verses.text: Do not quench the Spirit;
verses.textZh: 不要銷滅聖靈的感動；

verses.text: do not despise prophetic utterances.
verses.textZh: 不要藐視先知的講論。

verses.text: But examine everything [carefully]; hold fast to that which is good;
verses.textZh: 但要凡事察驗，善美的要持守，

verses.text: abstain from every form of evil.
verses.textZh: 各樣的惡事要禁戒不做。

verses.text: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you entirely; and may your spirit and soul and body be preserved complete, without blame at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textZh: 願賜平安的神親自使你們全然成聖！又願你們的靈與魂與身子得蒙保守，在我主耶穌基督降臨的時候，完全無可指摘！

verses.text: Faithful is He who calls you, and He also will bring it to pass.
verses.textZh: 那召你們的本是信實的，他必成就這事。

verses.text: Brethren, pray for us.
verses.textZh: 請弟兄們為我們禱告。

verses.text: Greet all the brethren with a holy kiss.
verses.textZh: 與眾弟兄親嘴問安，務要聖潔。

verses.text: I adjure you by the Lord to have this letter read to all the brethren.
verses.textZh: 我指著主囑咐你們，要把這信念給眾弟兄聽。

verses.text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.textZh: 願我主耶穌基督的恩常與你們同在！
